toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.9"
# ///
"""Context-safe lookups into corpus/segments.jsonl (never read that file directly).

Usage:
  uv run scripts/lookup.py R01-037 [R01-039 ...]   # print segments in full (clipped at --max-chars)
  uv run scripts/lookup.py --timeline R01          # one line per segment: id, role, tool, flags, opening text
  uv run scripts/lookup.py --flagged [R01]         # only flagged segments (output cap, errors, compaction, ...)
  uv run scripts/lookup.py --grep "ABSTAIN" [R01]  # segments whose text contains a string (case-insensitive)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def line(s: dict, width: int) -> str:
    text = " ".join(s["text"].split())[:width]
    flags = f" [{','.join(s['flags'])}]" if s["flags"] else ""
    tool = f"·{s['tool_name']}" if s["tool_name"] else ""
    return f"{s['segment_id']} {s['role']}{tool}{flags} | {text}"


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("ids", nargs="*", help="segment ids, or a report id (RXX) to scope --flagged/--grep")
    ap.add_argument("--timeline", metavar="RXX")
    ap.add_argument("--flagged", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--grep", metavar="TEXT")
    ap.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=140, help="chars of text per line in list modes")
    ap.add_argument("--max-chars", type=int, default=6000, help="max chars per segment in full mode")
    ap.add_argument("--segments", default="corpus/segments.jsonl")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    segs = [json.loads(l) for l in Path(args.segments).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if l.strip()]
    scope = next((i for i in args.ids if len(i) == 3 and i.startswith("R")), None)

    if args.timeline:
        rows = [s for s in segs if s["report_idx"] == args.timeline]
        print(f"{args.timeline}: {len(rows)} segments · verdict={rows[0]['verdict'] if rows else '?'}")
        for s in rows:
            print(line(s, args.width))
        return 0
    if args.flagged or args.grep:
        rows = [s for s in segs if not scope or s["report_idx"] == scope]
        if args.flagged:
            rows = [s for s in rows if s["flags"]]
        if args.grep:
            needle = args.grep.lower()
            rows = [s for s in rows if needle in s["text"].lower()]
        for s in rows[:200]:
            print(line(s, args.width))
        print(f"({len(rows)} segments{', first 200 shown' if len(rows) > 200 else ''})")
        return 0

    by_id = {s["segment_id"]: s for s in segs}
    for sid in args.ids:
        s = by_id.get(sid)
        if not s:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.9"
# ///
"""Verify coding acts (JSONL) against the authoritative segment store.

Checks every act: segment exists; quote is an exact substring of the segment
text (whitespace-insensitive); quote <=200 chars; memo non-empty; no duplicate (segment_id, code).
Empty-text segments are skipped with a note (nothing can be quoted from them).

Usage (paths are CWD-relative unless overridden):
  uv run scripts/verify_quotes.py                             # acts dir: coding/acts, segments: corpus/segments.jsonl
  uv run scripts/verify_quotes.py --acts coding/acts/R07-p1.jsonl   # single packet
  uv run scripts/verify_quotes.py --segments seg.jsonl --text-field stored_text
  uv run scripts/verify_quotes.py --self-test                 # no corpus needed

Exits 1 if any act fails.
"""
import argparse
import json
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

FAIL = "FAIL"


def load_segments(path, text_field):
    segs = {}
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for n, line in enumerate(f, 1):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                s = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
                print(f"BADSEG {path}:{n}: invalid JSON ({e})")
                continue
            if "segment_id" not in s:
                print(f"BADSEG {path}:{n}: no segment_id field")
                continue
            segs[s["segment_id"]] = s.get(text_field) or ""
    return segs


def check_acts(act_paths, segs, max_quote):
    fail = total = skipped = 0
    seen = {}
    for path in act_paths:
        file_fail = 0
        for n, line in enumerate(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), 1):
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            try:
                act = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
                print(f"FAIL {path.name}:{n}: invalid JSON ({e})")
                fail += 1
                file_fail += 1
                continue
            sid = act.get("segment_id")
            code = act.get("code")
            quote = act.get("quote", "")
            if sid is None or code is None:
                print(f"FAIL {path.name}:{n}: act missing segment_id or code")
                fail += 1
                file_fail += 1
                continue
            text = segs.get(sid)
            if text is not None and text == "" and quote == "":
                skipped += 1
                print(f"SKIP {path.name}:{n} {sid}: empty segment text")
                continue
            total += 1
            problems = []
            if sid not in segs:
                problems.append("segment not found in segment store")
            elif quote not in text and " ".join(quote.split()) not in " ".join(text.split()):
                problems.append("quote NOT substring of stored segment text (whitespace-insensitive)")
